cohort: Pregnant women in the active phase of labor at Fatimah Maternity Hospital, Pertiwi Maternity Hospital, and Syekh Yusuf Gowa Hospital.
finding: AoP and HPD parameters on transperineal ultrasound were found to be significantly different between women who had vaginal delivery and those who underwent cesarean section, effectively predicting successful vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Transperineal ultrasound parameters (AoP and HPD) can predict the mode of birth, specifically successful vaginal delivery versus cesarean section.
